name: Wavedash
goal: Air dodge into the ground on the first frame in the air
why: A wavedash moves {char} along the ground without a dash or a run. After its 10 frames of landing lag {char} is standing, still sliding, and can attack, grab, shield or jump from wherever the slide has carried it, facing the same way as before.

tutorial.what: A wavedash is a jump with an air dodge into the ground on the first frame in the air. {char} lands at once and slides along the ground in landing lag.
tutorial.expect: Each wavedash is judged when {char} lands: whether the air dodge touched the ground, the frame L or R was pressed, and the angle of the control stick. After misses, the coach shows your presses frame by frame against the {J}-frame jump squat.

marks.1: Frame 1: jump pressed. Jump squat begins
marks.J: Frame {J}: last frame of jump squat. The stick is down and forward
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: first frame in the air. R pressed: the air dodge touches the ground

lessons.title: Jump squat, then the air dodge
text: Pressing jump puts {char} in {J} frames of jump squat on the ground. The game ignores L and R during jump squat, and a press there is not carried over.

Frame {J+1} is the first frame in the air. L or R on that frame starts an air dodge, and aimed down it touches the ground on the same frame: {char} lands in 10 frames of landing lag, sliding with the air dodge's speed.

marks.1: Frame 1: jump pressed. Jump squat begins
marks.2: Frame {f}: jump squat. L or R is ignored here
marks.J: Frame {J}: last frame of jump squat
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: first frame in the air. R pressed: {char} lands at once

cues.words: Jump squat: L or R is ignored

lessons.title: The angle sets the slide
text: The air dodge moves {char} along the stick's direction, and only its forward part carries into the slide. Near horizontal the slide starts fastest; at 45 degrees, about a quarter slower. Then {char}'s traction sets its length.
The stick must still point below the dead zone: at full tilt, about 17 degrees below horizontal at the shallowest. Flatter, the air dodge skims along the ground and ends in a helpless fall.

cue.words: Stick 17 degrees below horizontal: the longest slide

verdict.success: Wavedash: air dodge on frame {J+1}, stick at {angle} degrees from level.

into the ground.expect: An air dodge into the ground
into the ground.words: no air dodge touched the ground
into the ground.headline: No air dodge into the ground
into the ground.fix: Press L or R once {char} is in the air, with the control stick down and forward. A press during jump squat is ignored, and a stick held flat sends the air dodge along the ground without touching it.

first frame.expect: L or R on frame {J+1}, the first frame in the air
first frame.words: L or R pressed {frames} after the first frame in the air
first frame.headline: Late air dodge
first frame.fix: Press L or R on frame {J+1}: {J} frames of jump squat after the jump press, the first frame {char} is in the air. On each later frame {char} has risen higher, so the air dodge lands later and {char} can act later.

angle.expect: Stick within 30 degrees of level, forward or back
angle.words: stick at {measure} degrees from level; straight down is -90
angle.headline: Steep angle
angle.fix: Hold the control stick down and to the side, close to level: about 17 degrees below it gives the longest slide. The further down the stick points, the less of the air dodge's speed goes into the slide.

strict.expect: Stick within 20 degrees of level, forward or back
strict.fix: Hold the control stick down and to the side as close to level as the dead zone allows: about 17 degrees below it, the longest slide. Flatter than that, the air dodge misses the ground.

parts.name: Air dodge into the ground
parts.teach: Jump, then press R with the stick down and forward while {char} is still low. The air dodge touches the ground: {char} lands in 10 frames of landing lag and slides.

marks.1: Frame 1: jump pressed. Jump squat begins
marks.J+3: Frame {J+3}: R pressed with the stick down and forward
marks.J+5: Landed out of the air dodge: landing lag, sliding

parts.success: Air dodge into the ground: {char} slides.

coach.note: {char} is in jump squat on frames 1 to {J}: press L or R from frame {J+1} on.

parts.name: First frame in the air
parts.teach: Press R on frame {J+1}, the first frame in the air: {J} frames of jump squat after the jump press. {char} lands on that frame and slides.

marks.1: Frame 1: jump pressed. Jump squat begins
marks.J: Frame {J}: last frame of jump squat
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: R pressed. {char} lands at once

cues.words: Jump squat: L or R is ignored

parts.name: Angle and length
parts.teach: Wavedash forward or back with the stick close to horizontal, within 30 degrees of it. The flatter the stick, the faster the slide; too flat, and the air dodge misses the ground.

marks.2: Frame 2: stick back, 17 degrees below horizontal
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: R pressed. {char} lands at once
marks.J+2: Landing lag: the longest slide, backward

coach.note: {char}'s jump squat is {J} frames: press L or R on frame {J+1}.
